name: Agra
summary: Mughal architecture, riverside gardens and old-city markets, with the Taj Mahal as the centerpiece.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.description: Mughal-era mausoleum and gardens on the Yamuna riverfront; closed Fridays in this sample schedule.

attractions.name: Agra Fort
attractions.description: Historic Mughal fort complex overlooking the Yamuna.

attractions.name: Itmad-ud-Daula's Tomb
attractions.description: Riverside marble tomb often noted for its detailed inlay work.

attractions.name: Mehtab Bagh
attractions.description: Garden across the river with views toward the Taj Mahal.

attractions.name: Akbar's Tomb, Sikandra
attractions.description: Mughal-era tomb complex set within landscaped grounds.

attractions.name: Jama Masjid
attractions.description: Historic congregational mosque opposite Agra Fort.

attractions.name: Kinari Bazaar
attractions.description: Old-city market lanes known for textiles, wedding goods and crafts.

attractions.name: Chini ka Rauza
attractions.description: Smaller riverside mausoleum noted for its tile decoration.
